quote: How vain it is to sit down to write when you have not stood up to live!
source: Henry David Thoreau, Journal, 19 August 1851 (The Writings of Henry David Thoreau, Journal II, ed. Bradford Torrey, 1906)

evidence.locator: Entry headed Aug. 19 (1851); the sentence opens a paragraph and is followed by “Methinks that the moment my legs begin to move, my thoughts begin to flow”
